integrity: Analytic proof only. The key rank calculation is exact and uses a block lower-triangular Jacobian submatrix; no numerical or finite-search evidence is used as a substitute for proof. One close 2003 source was compared from its published abstract because lawful full text was not available.
limitations: Conditional on existence of a nondegenerate speed-ordered all-shock Lax chain; local persistence only; no claim for rarefactions, contacts, composite or undercompressive waves, loss of strict hyperbolicity, or global uniqueness across wave patterns.
title: Generic all-shock structural stability under strict hyperbolicity alone
